purpose: Cover-production contract for Stardust Station. The released Issue 1 cover is the approved masthead/trade-dress pixel reference; Issues 2-10 use that exact approved image only for recurring cover-brand continuity while their own assembled RexPrompt cover recipes control issue-specific imagery.

controls: series masthead identity and two-line title architecture
Star Splitter Visions publisher bug treatment
issue-title treatment when a canonical issue title exists
recurring cover margins and trade-dress geometry
doesNotControl: later cover cast count or staging

pixelReadGate.rule: Before generating any later Stardust Station cover, retrieve and inspect the actual approved Issue 1 cover pixels in active multimodal context. A repository path, description, hash, thumbnail metadata, remembered image, or statement that the cover was previously viewed does not satisfy this gate.
pixelReadGate.blockedBehavior: If the approved Issue 1 cover pixels cannot be visually inspected, stop before later-cover generation rather than reconstructing trade dress from text.

recipeAuthority.rule: The assembled current cover recipe controls the issue-specific selling image, cast, setting, composition, focal hierarchy, spoiler ceiling and exact required cover text. The approved Issue 1 cover controls only recurring cover-brand appearance at the scope above.
recipeAuthority.conflictResolution: If copying Issue 1 composition would conflict with the current issue recipe, follow the current issue recipe and preserve only the scoped trade-dress continuity.

worldAuthority.rule: Released Stardust Station interior pages plus the active visual-reference-pack control established character identity, station design, costume/species appearance and interior visual language. Approved current-production references may establish newer story state when applicable.

coverRules: One dominant selling idea per issue.
No generic cast lineup unless the current cover recipe explicitly requires an ensemble composition.
No superhero posing or fake action spectacle.
No generic cyberpunk neon or grimdark reinterpretation.
No legible environmental text or fake signage on covers unless explicitly required by the current recipe.
Only exact required cover lettering from the assembled recipe plus the established publisher bug may be rendered.
The cover must remain legible and compelling at thumbnail size.
Do not reveal the issue's decisive solution, late reversal or final image.
Issue 2 and Issue 3 currently have no canonical subtitle; do not invent one.
